summary: Jefferies Financial Group filed a preliminary pricing supplement on Form 424B5 for $1,000-per-note Senior Autocallable Contingent Coupon Barrier Notes due October 19, 2029, linked to the worst-performing of the iShares MSCI EAFE ETF, Nasdaq-100 Index and Russell 2000 Index. Terms include a $31.25 quarterly contingent coupon, quarterly autocall observations beginning April 16, 2027, pricing October 16, 2026 and issue October 21, 2026. Notes are senior unsecured Series A MTN obligations. This is a routine structured shelf takedown, not a special situation; no deal terms apply.
